# Release: Elastic Beanstalk Amazon Linux 2 platform updates on April 9, 2026

This release provides new versions for AWS Elastic Beanstalk platforms based on Amazon Linux 2. The release includes security updates. It also includes AMI, Docker, ECS based Docker, Go, Corretto, .NET, PHP, and Tomcat updates.

**Release date:** April 9, 2026

## Changes

The following table lists the changes included in this release.

###### Note

Be aware that at the time these release notes are published, the new platform versions might not yet be available in all the AWS Regions that
Elastic Beanstalk supports. It might take a few hours for the release to complete.

| **Category** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| **Security updates** | Applied all security updates published in the [Amazon Linux Security Center](https://alas.aws.amazon.com/alas2.html) on or before **April 8, 2026** to all Amazon Linux 2 platforms. |
| **Cross-platform updates** | Made these cross-platform updates:  | **Component** | **Update** | | --- | --- | | **AMI** | Updated the base AMI to version 2.0.20260406. | |
| **Platform-specific updates** | Made these platform-specific updates:  | **Platform** | **Update** | | --- | --- | | **Docker** | **Docker platform branch**  * Updated Docker Compose to version [5.1.1](https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/).  **ECS Docker platform branch**  * Updated ECS Agent to version [1.102.1](https://github.com/aws/amazon-ecs-agent/releases/tag/v1.102.1). | | **Go** | Updated Go to release [1.26.2](https://go.dev/doc/devel/release#go1.26.2). | | **Corretto** | **Tools Updates**  * Updated Ant to version [1.10.16](https://archive.apache.org/dist/ant/RELEASE-NOTES-1.10.16.html). * Updated Maven to version [3.9.14](https://maven.apache.org/docs/3.9.14/release-notes.html). | | **PHP** | Added PIE (PHP Installer for Extensions) version [1.4.0](https://github.com/php/pie/releases) to the PHP platform branch. | | **.NET** | Updated .NET 8 to version [8.0.25](https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/8.0/8.0.25/8.0.25.md). | | **Tomcat** | Updated Tomcat 9 to version [9.0.115](https://tomcat.apache.org/tomcat-9.0-doc/changelog.html). | |
| **Additional changes with this release** | Deployment logs are now available in S3 for more deployment policies and deployment types. |

**Security updates**

Applied all security updates published in the [Amazon Linux Security Center](https://alas.aws.amazon.com/alas2.html) on or before
**April 8, 2026** to all Amazon Linux 2 platforms.

**Cross-platform updates**

Made these cross-platform updates:

| **Component** | **Update** |
| --- | --- |
| **AMI** | Updated the base AMI to version 2.0.20260406. |

**AMI**

Updated the base AMI to version 2.0.20260406.

**Platform-specific updates**

Made these platform-specific updates:

| **Platform** | **Update** |
| --- | --- |
| **Docker** | **Docker platform branch**  * Updated Docker Compose to version [5.1.1](https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/).  **ECS Docker platform branch**  * Updated ECS Agent to version [1.102.1](https://github.com/aws/amazon-ecs-agent/releases/tag/v1.102.1). |
| **Go** | Updated Go to release [1.26.2](https://go.dev/doc/devel/release#go1.26.2). |
| **Corretto** | **Tools Updates**  * Updated Ant to version [1.10.16](https://archive.apache.org/dist/ant/RELEASE-NOTES-1.10.16.html). * Updated Maven to version [3.9.14](https://maven.apache.org/docs/3.9.14/release-notes.html). |
| **PHP** | Added PIE (PHP Installer for Extensions) version [1.4.0](https://github.com/php/pie/releases) to the PHP platform branch. |
| **.NET** | Updated .NET 8 to version [8.0.25](https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/8.0/8.0.25/8.0.25.md). |
| **Tomcat** | Updated Tomcat 9 to version [9.0.115](https://tomcat.apache.org/tomcat-9.0-doc/changelog.html). |

**Docker**

**Docker platform branch**

Updated Docker Compose to version [5.1.1](https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/).

**ECS Docker platform branch**

Updated ECS Agent to version [1.102.1](https://github.com/aws/amazon-ecs-agent/releases/tag/v1.102.1).

**Go**

Updated Go to release [1.26.2](https://go.dev/doc/devel/release#go1.26.2).

**Corretto**

**Tools Updates**

Updated Ant to version [1.10.16](https://archive.apache.org/dist/ant/RELEASE-NOTES-1.10.16.html).

Updated Maven to version [3.9.14](https://maven.apache.org/docs/3.9.14/release-notes.html).

**PHP**

Added PIE (PHP Installer for Extensions) version [1.4.0](https://github.com/php/pie/releases) to the PHP platform branch.

**.NET**

Updated .NET 8 to version [8.0.25](https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/8.0/8.0.25/8.0.25.md).

**Tomcat**

Updated Tomcat 9 to version [9.0.115](https://tomcat.apache.org/tomcat-9.0-doc/changelog.html).

**Additional changes with this release**

Deployment logs are now available in S3 for more deployment policies and deployment types.
